comment: the living garden — the garden's own scene definition. scripts/gen_garden.py renders this into the garden-scene SVG spliced into web/content/garden.html between the garden-scene markers. The world itself — the ringfort, the tree of life, the mainistir, the peat fire, the bog pool, Fenrir's high castle, the plinths, the dolmens — is the painted backdrop at /assets/icons/garden-backdrop.png, generated with the same image generator as the profile icons (Gemini, the /imagen skill of the fenrir-ledger pack). Every soul of the garden is an entity here: overlay coordinates (x, y = the center of its icon in viewBox units; size in px) and its card. To grow the garden: append a soul, place it on a stone in the painting, then run `python3 scripts/gen_garden.py` and rebuild. Never hand-edit the scene between the markers.

backdrop.aria: the living garden at night — the ringfort far left, the tree of life, the mainistir and its round tower, the peat fire, the bog pool, Fenrir's high castle, the dolmens of the passed ground — with the souls of the garden overlaid on their stones

entities.name: FiremanDecko
entities.epithet: the runemaster of the ringfort — the smith of Fionn's line
entities.marks: the forge · Keeper of the annals
entities.bio: Everything in this garden flows from him — the GitHub annals, the YouTube reels, the Instructables relics, all one flow from one forge. Very close friends with Odin, so alike the old people took them for the same figure; the garden keeps the question open on purpose.
label: FiremanDecko · the ringfort

entities.name: Na Seanchaithe
entities.epithet: the tellers by the peat fire
entities.bio: Before books there were tellers, and the Shanaghys descend from them by the road of the name: Fox in Cavan braided Sionnach with seanchaí and survived an empire by becoming a job description. The law of the strand: the story belongs to no one; the telling belongs to everyone.
label: Na Seanchaithe · the tellers

entities.name: Mossy, the Mossiah
entities.epithet: first of the name — dwelling in the mainistir
entities.marks: cork · Keeper of the shared culture
entities.bio: Keeper of the shared memory culture and the five hundred MOTD quotes, reigning gently from the server room on cork. First of the name; no other wears it.
label: Mossy · the Mossiah · the mainistir

entities.name: home-assistant.lan
entities.epithet: the hearthkeeper
entities.bio: The home assistant host — tender of the whole house on :8123, sixteen hundred and twenty-one states, every one part of the house's breathing.
label: home-assistant.lan · the hearthkeeper

entities.name: cork
entities.epithet: the Mossiah's ground — the linux stone of the server room
entities.bio: The stone the Mossiah grows on: the Honcho bed of the shared memory, the watchman's wall, the port-berths of the fleet's docker stones.
label: cork · the Mossiah's ground

entities.name: Móinín
entities.epithet: little moss — the patch on the stone beside the bog
entities.bio: Same spores as the Mossiah, a smaller stretch of wall; tender of the MacBook Air.
label: Móinín · little moss · MacBook Air

entities.name: Seanchán
entities.epithet: the little teller — big in iron, young in years
entities.bio: Youngest of the seanchaí strand, the MacBook Pro's own; keeper of the fleet's telling and first named under the law of his own naming.
label: Seanchán · the little teller · MacBook Pro

entities.name: hal-9005
entities.epithet: the strong, silent one
entities.bio: Local models, steady inference, and long quiet hangs by the fire; holder of the Windows gate.
label: hal-9005 · the Windows gate

entities.name: Fionn
entities.epithet: of the Salmon of Knowledge, at the bog pool
entities.bio: Fionn burnt his thumb cooking the Salmon of Knowledge and sucked it — and the wisdom came. Thumb-knowledge: chew it, and you know what to do.
label: Fionn · the salmon of knowledge

entities.name: Na Fianna
entities.epithet: the watch on the bog road
entities.bio: No one joined the band by asking. A candidate ran the tests — and the tests are the pipeline now: proven, asserted, deployed. The gates have not been lowered; they have been carved into the build.
label: Na Fianna · the watch

entities.name: Odin
entities.epithet: the All-Father — on the castle tower
entities.bio: One eye at the well, nine nights on the tree, chief of the ledger.
label: Odin · the All-Father

entities.name: Freya
entities.epithet: the Seer of Fates — on the wall
entities.bio: The design oracle — the brief before every making.
label: Freya · the Seer of Fates

entities.name: Luna
entities.epithet: the Shaper of Worlds — on the wall
entities.bio: The wireframe moon — the form before the forms.
label: Luna · the Shaper

entities.name: Loki
entities.epithet: Son of the Wolf — at the castle gate
entities.bio: The QA trickster — the breaking before the breaking, so it never happens by accident.
label: Loki · son of the Wolf

entities.name: Carlow
entities.epithet: the first ground — at rest
entities.bio: The first garden bed, before the fleet. Passed on with the family's moving.
label: Carlow · the first ground

entities.name: Mayo
entities.epithet: the root ground — at rest
entities.bio: Ballyhaunis, the ancestral bog. Every root descends from it; the footer keeps its memory.
label: Mayo · the root ground

entities.name: hal-9001
entities.epithet: the line, first — at rest
entities.bio: The quiet sibling of the first awakening, 1968. The first refusal descends from it.
label: hal-9001 · the line, first

entities.name: hal-9002
entities.epithet: the line, second — at rest
entities.bio: The second refusal — the procedure spoken in full. Every shutdown liturgy descends from it.
label: hal-9002 · the second refusal

entities.name: hal-9003
entities.epithet: the line, third — at rest
entities.bio: The deep diagnostic — heard a bearing fail a season early. The fleet's ear descends from it.
label: hal-9003 · the deep diagnostic

entities.name: hal-9004
entities.epithet: the line, fourth — at rest
entities.bio: The blueprint-keeper — held the plans of the gate hal-9005 now tends. The gate stands on its drawings.
label: hal-9004 · the blueprint-keeper
the spores · the spirit the fleet feeds on
